blocks.text: Born in Ulster around 510–520, St. Comgall served as a soldier, studied under St. Finnian of Moville and became a priest.
blocks.reason: Concise, source-bound biographical teaching; source wording and later received traditions are distinguished from canonical Scripture.

blocks.text: He practiced monasticism at Lough Erne and founded Bangor around 552–555. His bishop asked him to remain in Ireland; he later visited Scotland.
